findings.description: The Lambda function embeds a static AWS access key ID and secret access key in plaintext environment variables. These land in Terraform state and are readable by any principal with lambda:GetFunctionConfiguration, enabling credential theft and use of the associated IAM identity. Secrets should come from Secrets Manager/SSM Parameter Store or the function's execution role.

findings.issue_category: missing CMK encryption for env vars
findings.description: No kms_key_arn is set, so the environment variables - which here hold credentials - are protected only by the default AWS-managed Lambda key and are returned in cleartext to anyone who can read the function configuration. A customer-managed KMS key with a restricted key policy is required to constrain who can decrypt these values.
The function targets the nodejs12.x runtime, which AWS has deprecated and no longer patches, so known vulnerabilities in the runtime and its bundled libraries remain unfixed.
